text:
jamie: Quick FYI — after last night's failover the rotor left eu-west skewed, seeing sustained p95 regressions for small-chat routes. GPU util ~55% but tokens/sec tail is down.

omar: Numbers? graphs?

jamie: p50 ~ 30ms, p95 ~ 1.2s, p99 ~ 2.8s for text.generate.small-chat on dedicated-pool-eu-west (pool-A). Throughput drop ~18%.

maria: Any NIC or thermal alerts on those hosts?

jamie: No NIC or thermal alerts. Telemetry shows allocation imbalance: pool-A 86 workers (72%), pool-B 17 workers (14%), warm_pool 12 workers. Rotor favored pool-A during inter-region reshuffle.

ryan: Known rotor behavior: during failover it biases lower AZ latency and ignores recent warm_pool heat. We didn't account for warm cache locality.

tayler: Short-term mitigation: can we shift low-priority traffic to preemptible lanes or hosted API for 10-15m? That reduces tail but moves cost/latency elsewhere.

jamie: I ran a quick status call: `curl -s https://internal-api/pools/eu-west1/status | jq .` -> {"pool-A": {"workers": 86}, "pool-B": {"workers": 17}, "warm_pool": {"workers": 12}}

omar: Why is warm_pool tiny? Autoscaler failed?

jamie: Autoscaler attempted scale_up at 03:08 UTC and errored: `Error: insufficient quota for gpu-v100, attempt=1/3` — left some slots pending.

maria: If we nudge 20% of traffic from pool-A -> pool-B it should lower p95. Command is `tools/pool-rotor shift --from pool-A --to pool-B --percent 20 --dry-run`. Dry-run shows exact worker moves.

ryan: Dry-run will also estimate KV cache cold-miss spike. Expect some cache thrash.

jamie: Dry-run says move 18 workers, expected p95 to improve by ~0.45s, kv_miss_rate +8% for moved tenants.

tayler: Cost analysis: spinning up 48 GPUs to increase warm_pool costs ~ $4.8k/day. Rotation is cheaper but has transient degradation for moved tenants. Prefer rotation + preemptible fallback for non-prod traffic.

omar: I'll chase cloud quota ticket now so scaler can resume.

maria: Plan: (1) dry-run now, (2) commit rotation in +5m if metrics look sane, (3) divert non-prod small-chat traffic 15% -> preemptible for 10m using `route.weight.adjust`. Rollback via `tools/pool-rotor revert --tag <run-id>`.

sre-bot: [ALERT] dedicated-pool-eu-west1 p95 latency > 1s (3m rolling). Incident INC-2026-0423-euw-rotor.

jamie: I'll post dry-run output and monitoring. @maria please own the commit. @omar handle quota ticket with cloud.

maria: committing in 2m. Will annotate run-id and post snapshots.

ryan: Also, file infra ticket to update rotor heuristics to include warm_pool weight so future failovers don't concentrate hot workers. infra#2347.

tayler: +1. Also add an alert for warm_pool worker count < 25 so we preemptively act.

jamie: Thanks all — will update once commit completes. :thumbsup:
